svg.text: ECB FX; break and lag checks
every trap, check and call logged
guide + own error, or best rule
Q3, Q4, CYC, ODM: hashed, scored
Every source is a row in its pipeline's data_config.csv (retrieval, validation, grade); every judgment call a row in its step's decisions.csv; every trap a row in audit/pitfalls.csv.
Each guided forecast = guide × (1 + expected guide error) + chain terms + dated events + FX; one quarter past the guide, the graph model. Numbers on the boxes are read from the outputs at each run.
